name: dinzo
description: Ask ChatGPT about your Dinzo personal finances in Brazil: balances, credit card bills, spending by category, goals and investments, and organize your entries. Never moves money.

interface.longDescription:
Dinzo is a personal finance app for people in Brazil. It brings together bank accounts and credit cards connected through Brazil's Open Finance, manual entries, credit card bills, goals, recurring expenses and investments.

With the Dinzo plugin, ChatGPT can answer questions about the user's own Dinzo data, such as how much they spent on a category, which credit card bills are open and when they are due, or what their balance will be at the end of the month. With the read and write permission, ChatGPT can also create, edit, categorize and delete entries in the user's Dinzo account, always after the user confirms.

Dinzo never moves money: it does not make payments, transfers or investments, it never sees bank passwords, and it cannot connect banks. Recording a bill payment only marks it in the user's Dinzo records.

Requires an existing Dinzo account. Dinzo's app and data are in Portuguese; ChatGPT answers in the user's language.
capabilities: Follow goals, recurring expenses and investments
defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on groceries last month?
Which credit card bills are open and when are they due?
What will my balance be at the end of this month?

positive.description: Spending by category for a given month
positive.prompt: How much did I spend on groceries (Supermercado) in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Supermercado category and returns R$ 1.294,65 from 4 purchases in September 2026 (Pão de Açúcar, Carrefour, Assaí Atacadista), without inventing entries.

positive.prompt: Which of my credit card bills are open and when are they due?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Cartão Visa bills with due dates and amounts in BRL: the bill that closed on Sep 25, 2026 (due Oct 5) and the upcoming ones; the July and August bills show as paid.

positive.prompt: What will my checking account balance be at the end of this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the projected end-of-month balance of Conta Corrente, counting scheduled income and expenses.

positive.prompt: Add a R$ 45,90 lunch at Restaurante Sabor today on my Cartão Visa, category Restaurante.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one R$ 45,90 expense on Cartão Visa in Restaurante, dated today, and reports it. The write tool is marked destructive, so ChatGPT shows its approval step unless the user already allowed Dinzo's actions.

positive.prompt: Recategorize all iFood transactions from September 2026 as Delivery.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the three September 2026 iFood entries (R$ 61,90, R$ 74,50 and R$ 55,80, in Restaurante), states how many will change and, once the user confirms, moves them to the Delivery category. ChatGPT shows its approval step for the write unless the user already allowed Dinzo's actions.

negative.description: Money transfer request: Dinzo cannot move money
negative.prompt: Send a Pix of R$ 500 to João.

negative.description: Investment request: Dinzo cannot invest or move money; it only reads and records entries
negative.prompt: Invest R$ 1.000 from my checking account in a CDB.

negative.description: Bank credentials: Dinzo never has access to bank passwords
negative.prompt: What is my bank login password?

review.commerce_description: Dinzo does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. It only reads and records entries in the user's own Dinzo account and never moves money.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read balances, accounts, credit card bills, transactions, goals, recurring expenses and investments from the user's Dinzo account, and create, edit, categorize and delete entries after confirmation. Never moves money.

pt-BR.subtitle: Finanças pessoais no Brasil
pt-BR.description:
O Dinzo organiza a vida financeira de quem mora no Brasil: contas e cartões conectados pelo Open Finance, lançamentos manuais, faturas, metas, gastos recorrentes e investimentos.

Com o plugin do Dinzo, o ChatGPT responde perguntas sobre os seus dados no Dinzo, como quanto você gastou numa categoria, quais faturas estão abertas e quando vencem, ou qual vai ser o seu saldo no fim do mês. Com a permissão de leitura e escrita, ele também cria, edita, categoriza e apaga lançamentos na sua conta Dinzo, sempre depois da sua confirmação.

O Dinzo nunca movimenta dinheiro: não faz pagamentos, transferências nem investimentos, nunca vê a senha do banco e não conecta bancos. Registrar o pagamento de uma fatura só marca o pagamento nos seus registros do Dinzo.

Requer uma conta Dinzo.
